subject: Assurance Pack pricing & final discount for Q1 pilot
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@brightapps.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Feb 2025 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Inquiry: SLA options for Q1 pilot

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week — BrightApps is excited about the performance numbers. We’re evaluating Redwood for a 3-month paid pilot (ingestion + chat features) for an internal product. Before legal/procurement, procurement asked me to confirm the support and uptime packaging and the impact on pricing. Two specific asks: 

- Can you summarize the SLA tiers you’d recommend for a pilot and the delta in monthly cost?
- Is there any flexibility on onboarding credits and response SLAs (we may need P1 within 30 minutes during launch week)?

Our rough expected usage: ~8M tokens/month with spikes during launch, and we prefer hosted/dedicated options.

If it helps, I can put procurement on a follow-up thread. Appreciate a short breakdown.

Best,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Product, BrightApps
[phone redacted]

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@brightapps.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Feb 2025 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inquiry: SLA options for Q1 pilot

Olivia — thanks, glad the demo was useful. Short breakdown below (happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk through):

Recommended packs (hosted):
- Assurance Lite: 99.9% uptime, P1 response 1 hour, 9–5 M–F cover, no dedicated on-call. Delta: +15% over base generation pricing.
- Assurance Pack (recommended): 99.95% uptime, P1 response 30 minutes during business hours, 24/7 escalation for P1s, includes prefix caching and 20% batching optimisation baseline. Delta: +28% over base.
- Assurance Premium (dedicated): 99.98% uptime SLA, P1 response 30 minutes 24/7 with on-call rotation, fast failover between regions, priority onboarding. Delta: +45% and requires 3- or 12-month commit for Dedicated capacity.

Onboarding credit: standard is one week of waived usage for pilots; we can discuss an additional one-time credit for paid pilots.

Attachments: I’m attaching our SLA matrix with response times and the standard escalation flow. (See attached: Redwood_AssurancePack_SLA_v2.pdf)

If BrightApps needs P1 within 30 minutes for launch, Assurance Pack or Premium are the likely fit. If you can share expected daily peak QPS and tolerance for cold-starts, I’ll map to a cost estimate.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_AssurancePack_SLA_v2.pdf]

From: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@brightapps.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Feb 2025 11:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inquiry: SLA options for Q1 pilot

Diego — thanks for the clarity. A couple of follow-ups from procurement and infra: 

1) We prefer Assurance Pack but the 28% delta pushes the pilot cost higher than our runway. Would Redwood consider a one-time onboarding credit plus a volume discount (targeting ~20% off price) if we commit to a 6-month pilot with a short Dedicated burst during launch week?
2) For P1: we really need 30-minute acknowledgement and 4-hour remediation target during launch (not just business hours). Can that be included?
3) Procurement also asked for a short statement around audit readiness (SOC2 logs + retention) — can we get that as a statement or pointer to your compliance docs?

Happy to sync with Diego and procurement next week.

Thanks,
Ethan 
Director of Infrastructure, BrightApps
procurement@brightapps.com

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@brightapps.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia@brightapps.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 Feb 2025 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inquiry: SLA options for Q1 pilot

Ethan — appreciate the specifics. Quick response and proposal: 

- Commercial: we can offer a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to two weeks of expected usage for the pilot. For a deeper discount, approvals are required — I’ve looped in Marissa (cc’d) to confirm discount authority.
- SLA: we can include 30-minute P1 acknowledgement and a 4-hour remediation target during launch week as an addendum to the Assurance Pack. Outside of launch week, standard Assurance Pack business-hour targets apply unless you choose Premium.
- Compliance: SOC 2 and retention statements are in our compliance portal; I’ll paste the link and attach the SLA matrix.

Proposal summary (pilot):
- Assurance Pack (hosted) + launch-week accelerated SLA addendum
- One-time: 2-week onboarding credit
- Requested discount: 20% off Assurance Pack pricing if BrightApps signs a 6-month committed pilot (with a minimum monthly commit equivalent to your expected 8M tokens usage).

Marissa — can you advise if we can approve a 20% commercial concession for a 6-month pilot tied to a Dedicated burst for launch?

On attachments: Redwood_AssurancePack_SLA_v2.pdf (attached) and BrightApps_MA_Review_Notes.docx (internal notes).

— Diego
[Attachment: Redwood_AssurancePack_SLA_v2.pdf]

- Require a canary/rollback clause and explicit escalation path in the SOW (24/7 on-call handoff for P1s during launch week).
- Finance should get the funnel credit row (karthik, please confirm accounting and seat of cost).

Karthik — please confirm accounting treatment and whether we can approve an 18% concession under the RDW standard pilot discount playbook. Once confirmed, Diego should circulate a final SOW and DocuSign link.
